hooks.command:
echo '{"suppressOutput":true,"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"End-of-reply protocol:
1. At the very end of your reply, output a separator line of 75 `━` (U+2501) characters.
2. On the next line: `**Concise version:**`
3. Then rewrite this reply to make it concise and easy to understand. Preserve the key facts."}}'

jq -e '(.stop_hook_active == true) or ((.last_assistant_message // "") | contains("**Concise version:**"))' >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo '{"suppressOutput":true,"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"Stop","additionalContext":"Reply is missing its concise version.
1. Output a separator line of 75 `━` (U+2501) characters.
2. On the next line: `**Concise version:**`
3. Then rewrite this reply to make it concise and easy to understand. Preserve the key facts."}}'
